dialogues.speaker: Yu
dialogues.text: I'm, uh, watching the tea stand for my dad, 'cause he's sick.

dialogues.speaker: Yu
dialogues.text: ...I really wanted to go play with Mengmeng today, but I'm a grown-up now, so I have to help my dad out with the business.

dialogues.speaker: Yu
dialogues.text: It really blows. Grown-ups have so many responsibilities...
